notes: What windows-desktop needs from the application component that provides the configuration: the DesktopSettings of start and the build settings.

fields.webRoot: absolute path of the packaged web build (resources/web)
fields.outputRoot: absolute path where build writes desktop/build/web
fields.scheme: lowercase custom scheme, not http, https, file, data or javascript
fields.partition: string, the browser session partition name
fields.modeEvent: string, the same event name display-mode uses
fields.serverOrigin: exact origin of the server; secure unless explicit loopback
fields.externalOrigins: string[] of secure origins with no path or credentials the window may open
